title: Daily token usage bar
description: Shows consumption against **plan limits** (driven by subscription / usage services, not raw model quotas alone).
content:
Daily token usage bar

Shows consumption against plan limits (driven by subscription / usage services, not raw model quotas alone).

What this is

The daily token bar compares your consumption to the plan limit from Kahana subscription data—not only a raw model quota—so you see remaining headroom for the billing period.

How to use it

  • Glance under the composer or header for the bar and label.
  • After long chats or voice sessions, wait a few seconds for counts to refresh.
  • Upgrade or add packs from Kahana if you consistently hit the cap.

Notes and limits

Offline time may delay sync; reopen the assistant if numbers look stale.
